channel.title: The Colorado Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Colorado Sun (coloradosun.com)

item.title: Are Colorado flu shots at their lowest in years?
item.description: No. More Coloradans have received flu shots so far this season compared with the same period last year, state data shows.

item.title: How two state programs aim to address the need for affordable housing for Colorado teachers
item.description: A program in a bill set to be introduced this week proposes giving school districts state funds to build rental housing for teachers and other staff

item.title: Hours of tearful testimony result in pause to some Medicaid cuts for Coloradans with disabilities
item.description: The cuts would have capped hours and lowered rates for parents caring for adults and children with severe disabilities

item.title: Colorado GOP enters peak of campaign season facing big financial and leadership problems
item.description: Vice Chairman Richard Holtorf announced his resignation — the second vice chair to leave the job in less than a year. The party’s finances are so bad it had to take out a bank loan.

item.title: Jason Crow, John Hickenlooper will each donate to immigrant rights groups to offset donations linked to Palantir
item.description: Their donation announcements came after inquiries from The Colorado Sun last week and as criticism of Denver-based Palantir grows

item.title: Some Democrats want to impose new fees on beer, wine and spirits to fund Colorado addiction services
item.description: The fees would be $0.26 per bottle of spirits, $0.05 per bottle of wine and about $0.03 per six-pack of beer. Small breweries would be exempt.

item.title: Mikaela Shiffrin arrives at her fourth Olympics hardly burdened by the ghosts of Beijing
item.description: Shiffrin left China without a medal, crashing out in three races and failing to reach the podium in three othersv

item.title: After saying goodbye in 2025, Denver’s largest music festival is back on in a new neighborhood
item.description: The Underground Music Festival, which spent the past two decades bouncing around South Broadway, will reappear this summer in RiNo

item.title: 134 more people laid off from federal renewal energy lab in Golden
item.description: National Laboratory of the Rockies, formerly NREL, keeps shrinking under Trump administration changes

item.title: Laura Clellan, tapped as interim Colorado Parks and Wildlife boss, named sole finalist for the permanent job
item.description: Clellan, a retired Army commander, brings decades of leadership in fraught circumstances that allies say will help steady the state agency
